# layout.py

[简体中文](layout.zh.md) ｜ **English** ｜ [← Back to README](../../README.en.md)

Arranging elements horizontally, vertically, in a grid or around a circle.

This file contains a single class, `LayoutMixin`, a mixin that `board/__init__.py` composes into `MagicPen`.

---

## Classes and methods

### `LayoutMixin`

LayoutMixin - arranging elements horizontally, vertically, in a grid or around a circle.

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `arrange_horizontal(elements, gap=10)` | Lay out horizontally, placing bounding boxes edge to edge. |
| `arrange_vertical(elements, gap=10)` | Lay out vertically. |
| `arrange_grid_by_cols(elements, max_cols, col_gap=10, row_gap=10)` | Lay out in a grid. |
| `arrange_grid_by_rows(elements, max_rows, row_gap=10, col_gap=10)` | Lay out in a grid. |
| `arrange_circle(elements, center=None, angle_gap=None, clockwise=True, rotate_with=True)` | Lay out around a circle, spacing the elements evenly. |
